subject: Residual variances with equality constraits and fixing parameters

messages.author: 70e41f91254535cb
messages.subject: Residual variances with equality constraits and fixing parameters
parts:
Hi!

I am running a SEM model with 3 groups. On the residual variances, I want to fix some variances to 1 (depending on the group) and I want the rest of the variances to be equal between groups. Following I paste the part of the script for this specification which runs but is not correct:

' y1~~c(e1=NA,e1=1,e1=NA)*y1
  y2~~c(e2=NA,e2=NA,e2=1)*y2
  y3~~c(e3=1,e3=NA,e3=NA)*y3 '

Here I want the specify that e1 should be equal in group 1 and 3, but fixed to 1 in group 2; e2 should be equal in group 1 and group 2, but fixed to 1 in group 3; and e3 should be equal in groups 2 and 3 but fixed to 1 in group 1.

This script runs but it does not apply the equality constraints, i.e. I get different estimates for e1 in group 1 and group 3.

Anyone knows how to specify this properly? 

Thank you very much in advance!

Best, 
Anna

messages.author: 70e41f91254535cb
messages.subject: Re: Residual variances with equality constraits and fixing parameters
parts:
Dear Jeremy, 

I have finally found the solution which I post here.

' y1~~c(e1,x1,e1)*y1
  y2~~c(e2,x2,e2)*y2
  y3~~c(x3,e3,e3)*y3 
  x1==1
  x2==1
  x3==1 '

Thank you.
Anna

messages.subject: Re: Residual variances with equality constraits and fixing parameters
parts:
A better solution is this:

' y1 ~~ c(e1, x1, e1)*y1 + c(NA, 1, NA)*y1
y2 ~~ c(e2, x2, e2)*y2 + c(NA, 1, NA)*y2
y3 ~~ c(x3, e3, e3)*y3 + c(1, NA, NA)*y3
'

as this avoids using constrained optimization.

Yves.
